Heatmap of Per-ICR Deviations

Source: R/module_icr.R
PlotICRHeatmap.Rd

Tiles of the per-ICR deviation from AnalyzeICRStatus(), samples in rows (grouped by Sample_Group) and ICRs in columns (maternal then paternal, by chromosome position). Altered ICRs are marked with a dot. A colour bar above the samples shows each ICR's annotated parental origin (legend "Annotated parental origin").

Usage

PlotICRHeatmap(
  icr_table,
  title = "Per-ICR deviation",
  limit = 0.4,
  outFile = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  show_sample_names = "auto",
  dpi = 200
)

Arguments

icr_table

Output of AnalyzeICRStatus().

title

Plot title.

limit

Colour-scale limit for the deviation (default 0.4).

outFile

Optional output path; the format follows the extension (.pdf, .png, .jpg, ...).

width, height

Size in inches. By default (NULL) the size follows the data: about 0.3 in per ICR and 0.12 in per sample plus margins (at least 6 x 5 in), so large cohorts stay readable; heights beyond 50 in are allowed.

show_sample_names

Show sample names on the y axis: "auto" (default; hidden above 300 samples, where the group strips still label the groups), TRUE or FALSE.

dpi

Resolution for raster formats (default 200).

Value

A ggplot object; its size in inches is stored in the attribute imprintomeR_figure_size (width, height) and used by export().
